new_jobs.title: Refugee School Impact (RSI) and Youth Mentoring (YM) Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
If you are passionate about transforming communities with a mission-driven organization, then we have the opportunity for you!

Reporting to the Client Services Supervisor, the Refugee School Impact (RSI) and Youth Mentoring (YM) Program Coordinator
leads the implementation of both programs. The coordinator will promote civic and social engagement, foster academic success, and support individual educational and vocational advancement for ORR-eligible refugee and immigrant children and youth within communities served by Global Refuge. This position helps young people and their families successfully integrate into their schools and communities through mentorship, educational support, and community engagement initiatives.

Global Refuge, formerly known as Lutheran Immigration and Refugee Service (LIRS), is a nonprofit serving newcomers seeking safety, support, and a share in the American dream. Since 1939, we have welcomed those seeking refuge, upholding a legacy of compassion and grace for people in crisis. We walk alongside individuals, families, and children as they begin their new lives in the United States through our work in refugee resettlement, care for unaccompanied children, and economic empowerment and employment. Our work also extends to Guatemala and Mexico, where we help young people with skills training and community reintegration. To date, we have served over 800,000 people from around the globe. Our comprehensive services leverage our extensive organizational expertise as well as government, community, and faith partnerships.

Benefits

Attracting and retaining the best talent is vital to our continued growth and we are proud to offer an excellent benefits package including:

medical, dental, vision available the first day of employment
generous paid time off including 20 days of vacation, 12 days of sick leave, 12 paid holidays
12 weeks of fully paid parental leave and up to 12 weeks of fully paid FMLA leave
company 403(b) contribution of 3%, an additional 7% match which vests immediately

At Global Refuge, welcoming newcomers isn't just our duty-it's an inherent part of our identity, rooted in our Lutheran heritage and inspired values and serving as a testament to our unwavering commitment to those in search of refuge. Please join us as we make a difference in the lives of newcomers.

Responsibilities/Duties

Provide culturally and linguistically appropriate, client-centered, and trauma-informed support to youth and families.
Conduct initial assessments to identify educational, social, and vocational needs and goals.
Develop individualized plans to address those needs through coordination with schools, educational and vocational services, and community resources.
Collaborate with schools, teachers, and administrators to support refugee students' academic progress and integration.
Coordinate after-school, tutoring, and enrichment activities that promote academic success and social inclusion.
Refer youth and families to relevant community services and facilitate access.
Recruit, screen, and train mentors, especially those from similar cultural backgrounds to provide positive role models and guidance for youth.
Partners with higher education institutions, job training programs, and community organizations to build pathways for youth advancement.
Document all client interactions, services, and activities in compliance with program and funding requirements.
Collect and report program data, success stories, and outcomes for both RSI and YM initiatives.
Maintain strong relationships with community partners, volunteers, and school staff to ensure effective program delivery.
Participate in outreach events and presentations to raise awareness and recruit participants and mentors.
Compile and submit programmatic and grant reports as required.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in education, public policy, economics, social sciences or related field or three years of experience providing community engagement, case management and/or social services preferred.
Knowledge and understanding of refugee resettlement systems, or other relevant cross cultural experiences a plus.
Strong understanding of school systems and youth development practices.
Ability to maintain a pleasant, customer-centered demeanor and professional image under a variety of challenging situations.
Proficient in the use of MS Word, MS Access, MS Excel and database programs.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment, troubleshoot, and follow projects through with attention to detail.
Ability to work as a team member and independently, with high level of self-motivation.
Exceptional interpersonal skills, including keen listening ability, relationship building, community outreach, and cultivating networks.
Exceptional presentation, training, and facilitation skills as well as oral and written communication skills.
Desire to connect with people from diverse backgrounds.
Must have reliable transportation, clean driving record, and valid insurance and be able to travel locally as required.
Cross-cultural or international experience preferred.
Deep commitment to Global Refuge's core values and ability to model those values in relationships with colleagues and partners

We participate in E-Verify in the states that permit its use.
